# JaroMed & Diagnostic Center

> JaroMed & Diagnostic Center is a primary healthcare and multi-specialty outpatient diagnostic clinic located in Dasmariñas, Cavite, Philippines.

## Main Navigation
- [Home](https://www.jaromed.com.ph/index.html): Primary landing page with consultation intake.
- [About Us](https://www.jaromed.com.ph/about.html): History, clinical leadership, and mission statement.
- [Services](https://www.jaromed.com.ph/services.html): Overview of outpatient and laboratory services.
- [Test Catalog](https://www.jaromed.com.ph/catalog.html): Comprehensive diagnostic test directory.
- [Our Doctors](https://www.jaromed.com.ph/doctors.html): Attending specialist directory.
- [HMO Affiliates](https://www.jaromed.com.ph/hmo.html): Accredited HMO partners and LOA guidelines.
- [Patient Portal](https://www.jaromed.com.ph/portal.html): Online portal for login, signup, and guest requests.

## Specialties
- [Cardiology](https://www.jaromed.com.ph/cardiology.html): 12-lead ECG, Holter monitoring, and vascular stress tests.
- [Radiology](https://www.jaromed.com.ph/radiology.html): Filmless digital X-ray and 3D/4D ultrasound imaging.
- [Genomics](https://www.jaromed.com.ph/genomics.html): Molecular testing, hereditary panels, and biomarker profiling.
